segments.he: מַתְנִי' כֹּל שֶׁחַיָּיב בַּמַּעַשְׂרוֹת — מִטַּמֵּא טוּמְאַת אֳוכָלִין, וְיֵשׁ שֶׁמִּטַּמֵּא טוּמְאַת אֳוכָלִין וְאֵינוֹ חַיָּיב בַּמַּעַשְׂרוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Any» food from «which» one is «obligated to» separate «tithes becomes impure with the ritual impurity of food; and there is» food «that becomes impure with the ritual impurity of food but» from «which one is not obligated to» separate «tithes.»

positions.claim: all titheable produce contracts food impurity; some food contracts impurity but is not titheable
